descriptions.general: Manage HomeRail interface and general preferences.
descriptions.nodes: Check Docker, manage Worker images, and verify running Worker versions.
descriptions.git: Manage Git server tokens. Projects and repositories are linked when adding a directory.
descriptions.providers: Manage providers, model capabilities, and locally encrypted model settings.
descriptions.voice: Configure voice output and button controls.
descriptions.experimental: Manage interface capabilities that are still being refined.
descriptions.skills: Inspect capabilities detected from the static Skills directory.
descriptions.plugins: Inspect resolved plugin capabilities and enable or disable optional scenes.
descriptions.default: Configure local capabilities used by HomeRail Agent UI.

general.title: General
general.description: These preferences apply to this device and are saved automatically.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose a visual appearance. Appearance plugins change semantic colors without changing component behavior.

cockpit.label: Cockpit blue
cockpit.description: A focused dark instrument panel with cyan accents.

paper.label: Soft Paper
paper.description: A low-glare workspace with misty slate tones and soft surfaces.

skin-01.label: Rose Garden
skin-01.description: A light rose theme with soft pink surfaces.

skin-02.label: Golden Fortune
skin-02.description: A festive palette of warm gold, red, and jade.

skin-03.label: Red Future
skin-03.description: A bright red-and-white interface with a sci-fi edge.

skin-04.label: Paper Crane
skin-04.description: A calm ivory theme with olive and paper-like tones.

skin-05.label: Inspiration
skin-05.description: An energetic palette of teal, coral, and yellow signals.

skin-06.label: Violet Night
skin-06.description: A dreamy layered theme of violet, blue, and soft light.

skin-07.label: Future Notes
skin-07.description: A neon music theme with cyan and pink-violet accents.

skin-08.label: Black Gold Stage
skin-08.description: An immersive dark theme with warm gold highlights.

skin-09.label: Astronaut
skin-09.description: An exploration theme of deep space blue and cool starlight.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by the HomeRail interface.

updates.title: Desktop updates
updates.description: Choose which signed, published HomeRail Desktop releases this device can receive.

stable.label: Stable
stable.description: Receive final releases only. Beta prereleases stay hidden.

early-access.label: Early Access
early-access.description: Follow the Beta channel and automatically receive future Beta and Stable releases.

updates.waitingForStable: This prerelease will stay installed until a newer Stable version is available. HomeRail will not downgrade it.

state.not-available: No newer update on this channel

experimental.title: Experimental features
experimental.description: These features are still being validated and may change as feedback comes in.

liveVoiceImmersive.title: Live Voice immersive interface
liveVoiceImmersive.description: After Codex Live Voice connects, automatically collapse the top bar, sidebars, and composer so only generative UI and the bottom input waveform remain. Restore the full interface when the connection ends.

guidance.installWindows: Install Docker Desktop, start it, and make sure it uses Linux containers.
guidance.installLinux: Install Docker Engine and start the docker service.
guidance.startWindows: Start Docker Desktop, wait until the Engine is running, and make sure it uses Linux containers.
guidance.startMac: Open Docker Desktop and wait for the Docker Engine to finish starting.
guidance.startLinux: Start Docker, for example with sudo systemctl start docker.
guidance.permissionLinux: HomeRail cannot access Docker. Check Docker Desktop permissions, or add the Linux user to the docker group and sign in again.
guidance.linuxEngineWindows: HomeRail Workers require Linux containers. Switch Docker Desktop to Linux containers.
guidance.sourceUnavailable: This installation does not contain the Worker build source, so it cannot rebuild the image on this host.
guidance.worker_image_missing: No Worker image is available. Select “Prepare Worker”.
guidance.worker_image_build_failed: The last build failed. Expand the build log, resolve the problem, and retry.
guidance.unknown: Select “Check again” and wait for Manager to confirm Docker and Worker image readiness before starting a DAG run.
guidance.checkFailed: Docker could not be checked. See the Manager log for details.

storage.description: Configure how long completed run workspaces are retained.
